title: Diagnostic Report

kind.server_restarted: The backend restarted while a task was running

description.runtime_crashed: Normal completion was not confirmed. A report has been retained locally. Send its link to the maintainer.
description.connection_lost: The connection repeatedly failed or disconnected. This may be a network or backend problem; it does not prove the task stopped.
description.server_restarted: The backend run changed and an active task may have been interrupted. Operations with unknown results are not replayed automatically.

complete: Collected {{files}} log files. Conversation text, tool output, tokens, private URLs, error messages and arbitrary console text are excluded; backend log lines keep only fixed lifecycle labels.
incomplete: This report is incomplete: some backend logs are unavailable or outside retention/collection limits. Client records are retained; collect again after reconnecting.
restoreMissing: The full report has not been restored from local storage. Resuming upload is disabled. Collect again or save the current summary.
previewLimited: Only the first 12000 characters are previewed. Download and upload include the entire report.
sendToMaintainer: Send this link and a description of the problem to the maintainer.
partialUpload: Uploaded {{count}} / {{total}} parts. Existing links are retained; resume to complete the report.
consent: I agree to upload this redacted report to the third-party service mclo.gs. Anyone with the link can read it.
uploadFailed: Upload failed. The report and successful links remain on this device. Retry or save locally.
copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the link manually.
